summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helpers, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py with an explicit import, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). All lines are within 120 columns. Tests were not run and black was not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data list key raises ValueError, and a non-object top-level JSON value gets the missing-key ValueError.
